keywords: 后量子 attestation 聚合者 EIP 合并
summary: chunter-cb 对 EIP-8130 的授权模型做大幅修订并合并：管理员即 `scope == 0x00`，scope 授权分为 `SENDER`、`POLICY`、`NONCE`、`SELF_PAYER`、`SPONSOR_PAYER`；付款权限拆成自付和代付；ERC-1271 签名不再是单独授权，而是操作权限的编码；账户锁简化为先锁后解。后量子 attestation 聚合者 EIP 合并为 Draft。当晚召开 ACDT #87，据 Ethereal news #31，glamsterdam-devnet-8 的重定价 EIP 将有小改动。

summary_en: chunter-cb merged a major revision of EIP-8130's authorization model: admin is `scope == 0x00`, and scope grants are `SENDER`, `POLICY`, `NONCE`, `SELF_PAYER` and `SPONSOR_PAYER`; payment authority splits into self-pay and sponsorship; ERC-1271 signing is no longer a separate grant but an encoding of operational authority; and the account lock is simplified to lock then unlock. The post-quantum attestation aggregators EIP merged as a Draft. ACDT #87 was held in the evening; per Ethereal news #31, glamsterdam-devnet-8's repricing EIPs will get minor changes.
